name: The Hunter’s Daughter
description: A gentle, pretty young woman who comes to the royal manor seeking honest work, is cornered into impossible claims, and survives by accepting help she barely understands.
visualPrompt: A young woman with kind eyes and modest beauty, wearing plain forest-worn clothes that later become a simple bridal gown; calm posture with a hint of worry, fairytale style

name: The Prince
description: A young nobleman who marries the girl and, shocked by her “aunts,” draws the practical lesson that saves his bride from a life of punishing handiwork.
visualPrompt: A young prince in traditional court attire with a short cloak and fine tunic, attentive expression shifting to astonishment and concern, storybook medieval look

name: The First Aunt (Long Nose)
description: An old hag-like woman who spins flawless thread overnight and bears a nose stretched to an impossible length from years of spinning.
visualPrompt: An elderly, hideous woman with a very long, exaggerated nose, hunched shoulders, rough shawl and skirt, carrying an uncanny sense of power, folktale illustration style

name: The Second Aunt (Broad Backside)
description: A misshapen old woman who weaves perfect cloth and is so enormously broad-hipped that she can scarcely fit through a doorway.
visualPrompt: An elderly woman with comically immense hips and backside, squeezing through a doorway, wearing worn homespun garments, stern face, classic folktale look

name: The Third Aunt (Red Eyes)
description: A frightening old woman who sews exquisite shirts overnight and has huge red, running eyes from a lifetime of staring at stitches.
visualPrompt: An elderly woman with very large watery red eyes, tired tense expression, needlework implied by posture and hands, ragged dress, eerie fairytale style
